title: Defecation Postures for Functional Consumption
brief_summary: Whether functional consumption is influenced by defecation postures is unclear. The investigators investigated effects of defecation postures on functional consumption.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subject has functional constipation
* Subject does not receive other treatments

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of heart cerebrovascular disease
* History of other types of constipation
* Pregnant, trying to become pregnant or breast feeding
* Age\< 18-year and \>70-year
